text:
hazel: Final announce checklist for next Tue launch. Need: changelog link, docs preview with runnable snippets, exact canary windows, HubSpot tag + routing, and a 1-line eng quote by EOD. Embargo 10:30 UTC. Can eng confirm rollout plan? @omar
omar: Working on it. Proposed ramp: 3% x 15m -> 15% x 30m -> 60% x 25m -> 100%. Abort if 5xx > 0.75% OR p95 latency > 340ms. I'll post the canary playbook doc in 20m.
lina: Docs preview up: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/175. Includes curl + JS quickstart and an embeddings example. Will swap model string once Omar confirms.
hazel: Marketing will use the preview for the blog + webinar slide deck. Need the changelog commit to link release notes.
omar: Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/mno345. Blurb: "Adaptive prefix cache + smarter batching to lower tail latency and cost on long-context workloads." Fine to use in announce.
chris: For inbound routing use hubspot tag `launch_q3_beta`. Routing: tag -> marketing/sdr queue; if trial created or usage>80 reqs/day -> escalate to sales/tier1 webhook. I'll add the rule IDs to the ops doc.
hazel: Social cadence: blog T+0, thread T+10, demo clip + webinar CTA T+45. Webinar CTA: https://redwood.ai/webinar/launch-q3. Put reg link in blog CTA.
lina: Added CTA placeholder and a small migration note. Will update model param once Omar confirms `rwd-serve-v2`.
omar: Confirm model `rwd-serve-v2`. APAC will be staged 45m after full rollout to avoid cold-cache amplification.
hazel: Can we do a 20m dry-run T-30m before publish for go/no-go and quick asset parade?
omar: Yes — I'll run the dry-run at T-25m (health checks, logs, rollback ready). Checklist: canary traffic, p50/p95, top errors, latency histograms, rollback command.
lina: I'll demo the quickstart and update the snippet during dry-run.
deploy-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by omar for 2026-07-14T09:15:00Z
hazel: One more ask: marketing needs a 1-line quote from eng for the header. Omar?
omar: "This rollout reduces tail latency for long-context inference by combining adaptive prefix caching with workload-aware batching, improving responsiveness and lowering unit cost." Use as-is.
hazel: Perfect. I'll lock the blog draft once you paste the final changelog hash and the docs permalink. Scheduling T-30m embargo ping in #marketing. :rocket:
